🔥 secureml | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling developers to build AI applications that handle sensitive data in a privacy-preserving and compliant manner.
✨ Key Features: • Data Anonymization Utilities (K-anonymity, Pseudonymization, Masking) • Privacy-Preserving Training (Differential Privacy, Federated Learning) • Compliance Checkers • Synthetic Data Generation (SDV integration) • Regulation-Specific Presets (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, LGPD)
📖 Summary: SecureML is a Python library designed to build privacy-preserving AI applications. It offers utilities for data anonymization, differential privacy, federated learning, and synthetic data generation, ensuring compliance with data protection regulations like GDPR.
